profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Calm, thoughtful Flandres dogs and playful, curious Ardennes dogs show contrasting characters within the cattle-dog family. Cattle driving and stock guarding run through its working history. Australian Cattle Dogs and both Welsh Corgis also belong to this family, with each breed keeping its own working style.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A cattle-dog family with contrasting characters, from the thoughtful Flandres to the lively Ardennes.
